delayInicial.description: Tempo de espera, contado a partir do evento "cc:landed", antes do fade in começar.

deadZone.title: Dead Zone
deadZone.description: Radial thickness of inner dead zone of the virtual joystick. This dead zone ensures the virtual joystick reports a value of 0 even if a touch deviates a small amount from the initial touch.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: The radius of the virtual joystick in CSS pixels.

runThreshold.title: Run Threshold
runThreshold.description: How far past the joystick radius (as a multiple of it) the player needs to drag before switching from walking to running. 1 = right at the visible edge, 2 = twice the radius past center, etc. The joystick knob visually travels out to this same distance, so raising this value directly increases how far the knob (and thumb) has to move to trigger running. Set very high to effectively disable running.

lookSensitivity.title: Look Sensitivity
lookSensitivity.description: Degrees of camera rotation per pixel of finger drag on the right side of the screen.
